# PR #2086: Patch: Stinkyscape S22, Terminus

Closes #1870

## What this does

This fills the eight Stinkyscape S22 stubs with scripts and tests. The cards are `#4` Olivian Expanse, its six Terminus tokens (`#4.1` Farewell, `#4.2` KY's Last Exam, `#4.3` Event Horizon, `#4.4` Last Word, `#4.5` 1v1 Final Destination, `#4.6` The Big Crunch) and `#154` Dice of Doom. It follows the issue's plan, steps 1–26.

The set stays held by R1420's gate. There is no pending fragment, no golden trace moves and the shipped totals are unchanged. In `catalog.json` only the eight `loc` values change; each equals `cargo jackioh catalog loc` for its script.

### Engine: five new pieces, each tested in `crates/engine/tests/rules/terminus.rs`

| Piece | Where | Ruling |
|---|---|---|
| **A win a card carries.** `effects::WIN_ON_PLAY_KEY` in one card's `memory`. `place_card` (§10.5 step 4) takes the key off and sets the player's won flag. The state check that closes the play holds it, and a hero at 0 still loses first. | `effects/win.rs`, `play_steps.rs` | R1870000 |
| **Exile every permanent, each Stack pile whole.** `exile_all_piles` repeats until a pass finds nothing new. A Dormant card stays. | `effects/move_.rs` | R1870001 |
| **Echo a card gives itself.** `gain_echo` works only on a card that is resolving. One play can give itself at most `SELF_ECHO_GAIN_CAP` (20) repeats, counted in the card's memory. That count is cleared when the card leaves the resolving zone. | `effects/buff.rs`, `config.rs` | R1870002 |
| **"Your Units have Charge" for the next turn.** A new modifier kind, `ModifierKind::UnitsKeyword`, made by `give_units_keyword_next_turn` with expiry `nextTurnOf`. `layers.rs` reads it beside the auras' keywords, and `view_for` gives it a label. | `state.rs`, `effects/player_mods.rs`, `modifiers.rs`, `layers.rs`, `view_for.rs` | R1870004 |
| **A keyword kept for good.** `gain_keyword_for_good` writes the keyword into the card's tuning, so every zone keeps it. | `effects/tune.rs` | R1870007 |

`ModifierKind.ts` and `PlayerModifier.ts` in `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` were regenerated by `cargo test`.

### Cards

- Each card has its script and a `mod r18700NN_*` test module in its own file.
- There is one test for each BUILD M12 clause, base face and Radiant face.
- KY's Last Exam draws its problems from a new bank, `crates/cards/src/ky_last_exam_bank.rs`: eight problems, each with four different options.
- The AI's answer to KY's Last Exam is tested in `crates/ai/tests/ai/answer_key.rs`, because the cards crate cannot reach the AI.

### Spec

- **Rulings:** eight new notes, R1870000–R1870007, from the first numbers of #1870's block, plus a paragraph in §11. `spec/INDEX.md` is regenerated.
- **§6.3 (`spec/06-keywords.md`):** five new rows, one per new piece: Win on play, Exile all piles whole, Gain Echo, Units keyword next turn, Keyword for good.
- **§8.10 (`spec/08-catalog.md`):** the eight Engine cells said "NEW (S22)". They now name what was built and its ruling:
  - `WIN_ON_PLAY_KEY` and the seven-card `TERMINUS_CARDS` pool;
  - `exile_all_piles`, with the caster's graveyard emptied first;
  - `ky_last_exam_bank.rs`, `gain_echo` and `SELF_ECHO_GAIN_CAP`;
  - the ✓ label as the cheat sheet;
  - `give_units_keyword_next_turn`;
  - for Last Word, the loss in its next turn's end-of-turn delayed effects, and the opponent's owed extra turns coming first (R846);
  - for 1v1 Final Destination, the controller's hand discarded first, and a discard-guarded hand keeping its Spells (R800);
  - `gain_keyword_for_good`.
- §7, BUILD M12 and `docs/radiant-audit.md` already match this build, so they are unchanged.

### One file the plan didn't list

`apps/web/src/cards/rules.test.ts` (test B11) failed on the five new §6.3 rows. It requires every row to be a glossary term or a rules-only row. These five are engine readings of words the cards print plainly, so I added them to `RULES_ONLY_ROWS`, the way earlier Stinkyscape verb rows were added. No check is weakened.

### Merge with `main`

Merging `main` left a conflict in `spec/11-rulings.md`. I kept both paragraphs: `main`'s R1866 paragraph first, then R1870's.

## How I tested it

Everything below was run in this session on the merged tree:

- **Basic checks:** `cargo fmt --check`, `catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check` all pass. `spec index` changed nothing after the merge.
- **Clippy:** `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` exits 0.
- **Rust tests:** `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` exits 0 with 15,157 passed, 0 failed and 14 ignored (the existing daily tests).
  - 68 of the passing tests are this issue's: 10 in `rules::terminus`, 57 in the card files and 1 in the AI test.
  - `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` is empty after the run.
- **Fuzz:** `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` exits 0, and Farewell is played in those games.
- **Golden:** `golden check` replays 240 of 240 games identically.
- **Web:** after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, the harness's command (`vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …`) first failed on B11 only. After the fix: 332 files, 6,404 tests passed, 1 skipped. `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint on the edited file both pass.
- **Classify:** `classify --base origin/main --parent-bin <base build> --claims` prints `classify: App` and exits 0. No shipped card plays differently. I ran it from a throwaway clone under `/tmp` holding this diff as one commit, now deleted.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

All are recorded in the ruling notes. A person may overrule any of them.

- **KY's cheat sheet** is a ✓ after the right option's label, so only the chooser's prompt shows it. I rejected a `PendingChoice` flag with a new wire field and client rendering: about 8 more files across the engine, the AI and the web.
- **The AI** does not read the ✓, so it still guesses on the Radiant face.
- **KY's problems** are statements whose unknowns stay open, in maths notation. The designer's question E4, what the problem actually is, is still open.
- **Last Word** waits behind any extra turns the opponent is already owed, rather than clearing them. Its Units Charge badge reads "Your Units have Charge", with "during your next turn" until that turn comes.
- **1v1 Final Destination** discards its controller's hand first. The Radiant fill counts Spells a discard guard kept (R800) as still in the hand, so no Book of Buff burns.
- **Event Horizon** has no once-a-game cap. Only M #19.1 Temporal Rift prints one (R847).
- **The Big Crunch** casts one of each edition in catalog order.
- **Dice of Doom's** Embiggened Lucky counts toward that same play's roll, and every roll is made, hit or not.

## Worth a second look

- **`layers.rs`** runs on every keyword read. The new branch first checks that the card sits in a unit zone, and only does more when that player has a live `unitsKeyword` modifier.
- **The win key** is in game state only on a Radiant Olivian Expanse's pick. Nothing else creates it, so no existing replay changes.
- **The Big Crunch's roll tests** count only the three editions that have scripts (`SHIPPED`). S #150 and S #151 are stubs until S25 (#1882), which must widen `SHIPPED` when it fills them.
